Q8231.reason: Asymptomatic close contact (shared room) needs eradication of meningococcal carriage; rifampin is standard chemoprophylaxis, while penicillin does not clear carriage and vaccine is not immediate post-exposure therapy.

Q8232.reason: Bedtime alcohol fragments sleep and causes early-morning awakening despite easy sleep onset; stopping it is first-line, and there is no depression to justify sertraline.

Q8238.reason: Classic Turner syndrome causes streak gonads and infertility, so family-building is by adoption; surgery, amniocentesis, or genetic counseling do not restore fertility.
